glossary_additions.source: Three exact corpus occurrences: 231:t_017:2, 231:t_018:4, 231:t_021:2. Basara and Ozma deliberately truncate Gepelnitch's name; the immediately following dialogue corrects it. https://macross.fandom.com/wiki/Gepelnitchi confirms character identity and alternative spelling Gepelnitch. Preserve the joke rather than silently expanding to the full name; this English nickname is a project proposal. Insults remain outside the token. No numeric binding.

26 source records across the full corpus, six in this batch, first 353:t_1:34. https://brucelee.com/jeet-kune-do and https://brucelee.com/bruce-lee confirm the martial art's English spelling. Hibiki attributes learning it to his father in the game's own dialogue. No numeric binding.

Four full-corpus occurrences: 353:t_1:36, 365:t_5:54, 341:t_2:98, 348:t_000:8; two in this batch. https://www.russianmartialart.com/whatis.php confirms the martial art's English spelling. The source identifies it as Crowe's martial art. No numeric binding.

282:t_10:22 pairs Grace with Seiei in Mileina's list of couples: Feldt Grace, not Macross Grace O'Connor. Whole-corpus scan found 70 records containing this spelling, with one in this batch; surname collision reviewed separately from the Macross character. Existing full-name token フェルト・グレイス and https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/Feldt_Grace confirm spelling and identity. Surname alias only; no new numeric binding.

One full-corpus occurrence, 354:t_103:3. Hibiki explicitly names this smile in response to Rand, and Mel criticizes the name in the following row. Transparent rendering of the source loanwords; web research found no independent attestation of this exact nickname. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/ヒビキ・カミシロ corroborates Rand teaching Hibiki to smile, but not this English label. Project proposal, no numeric binding.

18 full-corpus records, three in this batch: 236:t_1:23, 283:t_015:5, 353:t_2:116. https://gundam.fandom.com/wiki/GN_Particles identifies the term and its connection to human innovation and communications. English naming is wiki-sourced; no numeric binding.

Research of https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/ネオ・ジオン and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/UCW found related colony alliances, but no verified English name for this exact Tengoku wording; do not substitute the earlier game's Aprilius Alliance. One exact source occurrence, 366:t_018:0, explicitly Olson's machine. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/オーガスII confirms identity and Tengoku appearance; https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z/Unit_Database pairs Orguss II with Olson D. Verne. Distinct from the Orguss 02 OVA. Source uses single Unicode Roman numeral; preserve it in token. Wiki-sourced name, no numeric binding.

One source occurrence, 359:t_10:10: AG coins a pop-group name for Marida, Quess and Four. Preserve the source's Powered/Sisters loanword joke; do not substitute a different franchise group. Targeted web research found no independent attestation of the exact name or licensed English. Project proposal based on the game source.

glossary_additions.source: Two source occurrences, 371:t_1:26 and 758:t_1:591; Kappei names a business after his Jin surname, echoing Takeo General Company. Existing surname 神 = Jin and Kappei Jin profile establish the reading. https://mousousouko.blog10.fc2.com/blog-entry-1252.html independently describes the stage's proposed company joke. English is a transparent project rendering, not an official localized company name.

One source occurrence, 371:t_1:28: Watta teases Kappei with a countryside/hick plus Kappei pun, and Kappei objects in the next row. Preserve the pointed nickname rather than expanding to his ordinary name. Searches found no verified localized equivalent. Any allusion to the real performer Ina Kappei remains unconfirmed and is not inserted. Project adaptation, no numeric binding.

Nine full-corpus occurrences, two in this batch at 360:t_017:6 and 360:t_018:2. https://aquarion.fandom.com/wiki/Solar_Wing explicitly pairs the Japanese term with Solar Wing and describes both the Apollonius epithet and Aquarion reference. Preserve source ambiguity instead of replacing with a person's name. Wiki-sourced spelling, no numeric binding.

Two full-corpus occurrences, 360:t_015:6 and 360:t_018:9, Mikage's title for Kaworu. Preserve the source's end/emissary wordplay and the project's settled emissary rendering. https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/渚カヲル supplies Kaworu/Aquarion context but does not verify this exact English title; no licensed equivalent found. Project title proposal, no numeric binding.

One corpus occurrence, in チュウちゃん at 371:t_1:84. Umee greets Uchuta and Keiko, who answer in the following rows; retain the abbreviated pet name rather than expanding Uchuta. Existing Uchuta profile establishes the name; no independently attested English nickname was found. Romanization proposal; generic honorific omitted consistently with style. No numeric binding.
